On the default branch at {{ref}}, run the quick proof suite: `relay-proof --stage post-merge --ref {{ref}} --suite quick`. {{issue_contract}}
Map every proof back to the acceptance requirements — do not just file bugs. For each requirement the PR covers, record PASS, FAIL (with the observed failure) or NOT_VERIFIED: `relay-qa done <pr> --result pass|fail --map AC1=PASS --map AC2=FAIL:<what you saw> --proof <summary path>`. Example: AC1 PASS · AC2 FAIL — experiment 87 prospect 123 still has no next action · AC3 NOT_VERIFIED → ISSUE REMAINS ACTIVE. A FAIL or NOT_VERIFIED on a required item returns the issue to implementation automatically; only a complete contract closes it. Defects also become issues labelled `type:bug`, routed one tier higher if the miss was in review. A merge is "verified" only after this stage passes for the requirement; until then it is merged, not verified, and merged is not the issue complete. Report ≤{{report_max_words}} words.
